svg.title: Invoice Digitizer
svg.desc: Invoice Digitizer. Turns multi-page PDF invoices and phone scans into verified Excel sheets with Gemini vision, model failover and live mobile-to-desktop sync. 2,000+ invoices for a Tally to SAP migration · 4-week audit in 4 days.
